title: DSH 启动失败页 · 官方错误列表可滚动

assertions.message: failure page does not apply the loading card
long diagnostics scroll the last error into view
assertions.expression: (() => { const root = document.querySelector('[data-dsh-boot]'); const items = [...document.querySelectorAll('[class*="failedItem"]')]; const last = items.at(-1); const overflows = root.scrollHeight > root.clientHeight; root.scrollTop = root.scrollHeight; const visible = root.scrollTop > 0 && last.getBoundingClientRect().bottom <= root.clientHeight; root.scrollTop = 0; return overflows && visible })()
